sn34.50:1.2: samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī.
sn34.50:1.3: samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī hoti na samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo.
sn34.50:1.4: neva samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo hoti na samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī.
sn34.50:1.5: samādhismiṃ abhinīhārakusalo ca hoti samādhismiṃ sakkaccakārī ca.
